https://jobs.unicef.org/jobs/data-and-ai.snippet: The United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) is inviting applications for a Data and AI Governance Consultant to support its global data transformation and artificial intelligence initiatives across West and Central Africa. The consultancy offers an exciting opportunity for experienced professionals in data governance, artificial intelligence, digital transformation, information management and responsible technology adoption to contribute to UNICEF’s mission of protecting children’s rights and improving their lives. The successful consultant will support the implementation of data governance frameworks, artificial intelligence capacity-building initiatives, data maturity assessments and innovative digital solutions across multiple countries. The position is based in Dakar, Senegal, with a remote working arrangement and official travel as required. The consultancy has an initial duration of 12.8 months and will contribute to UNICEF’s Data Transformation Enabling Global AI (DT&AI) project. Application deadline: 20 November 2026.
